review.notes: Token-level alignment of all 12 extracted PDF pages against the OCR markdown; every unmatched run was resolved. Physical p.4 flagged runs were verified in the markdown by direct string check: the section 2.1 sentence 'directives like "Grab the mug" ... laws of physics.' (md line 67) and the two-line Figure 3 caption including 'Strip 2: Notice the real scene contains a mug to grasp, but the model, unaware of that object, still moves the gripper along the commanded trajectory and closes on empty space.' (md lines 70-71) are both present; the flagged run was a diff-alignment artifact, not droppage. All remaining unmatched text on physical pages 5, 8 and 9 consists of axis ticks, legends and in-plot labels of Figures 5 and 7, which are embedded images (18 embeds total); physical p.10 is a full-page figure page whose subcaptions (a)/(b) and the Figure 10 caption are present.
